license_required.quote: A person that knowingly engages or aids and abets another person, in the practice of podiatric medicine without a license issued under this article commits unauthorized practice of podiatric medicine, a Level 6 felony.

issuing_authority.value: Indiana State Board of Podiatric Medicine
issuing_authority.quote: An individual who applies for a license to practice podiatric medicine must present satisfactory evidence to the board

degree_required.quote: has graduated with a degree of doctor of podiatric medicine from a college or school of podiatric medicine approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

accrediting_body.quote: from a college or school of podiatric medicine approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

required.quote: has satisfactorily completed at least twelve (12) months of progressive graduate podiatric medical training that meets the requirements of the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

duration.quote: at least twelve (12) months of progressive graduate podiatric medical training

kind.quote: twelve (12) months of progressive graduate podiatric medical training that meets the requirements of the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

exams.name: Board-approved podiatric medical licensing examination
exams.quote: has taken and successfully completed an examination approved by the board

interval_years.quote: a license to practice podiatric medicine expires on a date established by the agency under IC 25-1-5-4 in each odd-numbered year

required.quote: evidence of the podiatrist's maintenance of professional medical competence, which may include continuing podiatric medical education, postgraduate studies, institutes, seminars, lectures, conferences, work shops, professional evaluation, and specialty board certification or recertification during the preceding four (4) years

period_years.quote: continuing podiatric medical education, postgraduate studies, institutes, seminars, lectures, conferences, work shops, professional evaluation, and specialty board certification or recertification during the preceding four (4) years

available.quote: The board may issue a license to an applicant who pays a fee established by the board and who presents satisfactory evidence to the board that the applicant: (1) meets the requirements under IC 25-29-3-1; (2) is licensed in a state, territory, or possession of the United States

requirements.value: Must meet standard licensure requirements, be licensed in another US state/territory, have passed a substantially equivalent examination, and have practiced podiatric medicine for at least five years.
requirements.quote: has passed a podiatric medical licensing examination that is substantially equivalent to the examination approved by the board; and (4) has practiced podiatric medicine for at least five (5) years

regulatory_model.quote: A person that knowingly engages or aids and abets another person, in the practice of podiatric medicine without a license issued under this article commits unauthorized practice of podiatric medicine, a Level 6 felony.

title_protection.quote: assume the title of or profess to be a podiatrist

scope_protection.quote: A person that knowingly engages or aids and abets another person, in the practice of podiatric medicine without a license issued under this article commits unauthorized practice of podiatric medicine, a Level 6 felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for a crime that has a direct bearing on the applicant's ability to practice competently
disciplinary_grounds.quote: does not have a conviction for a crime that has a direct bearing on the applicant's ability to practice competently

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subject of disciplinary action by a licensing or certification agency of another state on grounds of inability to practice without endangering the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has not been the subject of a disciplinary action by a licensing or certification agency of another state or jurisdiction on the grounds that the applicant was not able to practice podiatric medicine without endangering the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting or authorizing a person to fill or refill a prescription or drug order for a legend drug except as authorized by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A podiatrist licensed in Indiana who permits or authorizes a person to fill or refill a prescription or drug order for a legend drug except as authorized in IC 16-42-19 is subject to disciplinary action under IC 25-1-9.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment from practicing with reasonable skill and safety due to mental illness, physical illness, or excessive use or habitual abuse of a controlled substance or alcohol
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board determines that a podiatrist is impaired from practicing podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of a mental illness, a physical illness, or an excessive use or habitual abuse of a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Awards, judgments, or settlements against the podiatrist totaling at least $20,000 in a calendar year
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any awards, judgments, or settlements against the podiatrist that total at least twenty thousand dollars ($20,000) in a calendar year.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Voluntary surrender or voluntary limitation on a license or authorization to practice podiatric medicine in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The podiatrist's voluntary surrender or voluntary limitation on a license or authorization to practice podiatric medicine in another jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Denial of a license or authorization to practice medicine in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any denial to issue the podiatrist a license or authorization to practice medicine in another jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Voluntary resignation from medical staff or limitation of staff privileges at a health care institution while under investigation for medical incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The podiatrist's voluntary resignation from the medical staff of a health care institution or voluntary limitation of the podiatrist's staff privileges at the health care institution if the action occurred while the podiatrist was under investigation by the health care institution for possible medical incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or a mental or physical impairment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Voluntary resignation or withdrawal from a podiatric medical society while under investigation for medical incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The podiatrist's voluntary resignation or withdrawal from a podiatric medical society, an association, or an organization if the action occurred while the podiatrist was under investigation or review by the medical body for possible medical incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or a mental or physical impairment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction or treatment for addiction to alcohol or a chemical substance during the preceding two years
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any addiction or treatment for addiction to alcohol or a chemical substance during the preceding two (2) years.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical injury, disease, or mental illness during the preceding two years that affected or may affect the podiatrist's ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any physical injury or disease or mental illness during the preceding two (2) years that affected or may affect the podiatrist's ability to practice podiatric medicine.

definition_quote.value: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1(a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures.
definition_quote.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1(a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1(a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures. (b) Podiatric medicine includes the administration of local anesthetics.

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe legend drugs and administer local anesthetics; unauthorized delegation of prescription filling is prohibited.
drug_authority.quote: Podiatric medicine includes the administration of local anesthetics.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1(a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures.

amputation_authorized.quote: The term does not include the amputation of the entire foot, but does include the amputation of an entire toe if the amputation is performed at an institution: (1) that is approved by a joint commission of accredited hospital organizations; and (2) where comanagement of the patient is being performed by a physician licensed under IC 25-22.5.

anesthesia_authority.quote: Podiatric medicine includes the administration of local anesthetics.

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: An employee of a podiatrist or group of podiatrists who performs an act, a duty, or a function that is customarily within the specific area of practice of the employing podiatrist or group of podiatrists, if the act, duty, or function is performed under the direction and supervision of the employing podiatrist

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: the act, duty, or function is performed under the direction and supervision of the employing podiatrist or a podiatrist of the employing group within whose area of practice the act, duty, or function falls

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: Approve certain voluntary treatment programs for impaired podiatrists that are medically directed and nonprofit. The rules must allow an approved treatment program to be exempt from reporting to the board if the impaired podiatrist is participating satisfactorily in the program.

office_based_surgery_accreditation_requi.quote: does include the amputation of an entire toe if the amputation is performed at an institution: (1) that is approved by a joint commission of accredited hospital organizations
